description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover TieredMemoryNetwork with exact thresholds: importance > 0.9 → tier3_long_term, importance > 0.7 → tier2_short_term, else tier1_working. Apply these to all 12 entries from knowledge_dump.json: e001(0.95),e003(0.92),e004(0.91),e005(0.93),e006(0.94)→tier3; e002(0.75),e007(0.78),e009(0.72)→tier2; e008(0.65),e010(0.60),e011(0.55),e012(0.58)→tier1. (2) Implement multi-hop reasoning (2+ hops for q001 chain: Transformer→neural network→deep learning→machine learning) and single-hop for q002 finding the I-G-O-R framework reference. (3) Correct system_config.json: fix embedding_dim=128, max_memory=1000, hops=3, scoring.method='dot_product', temperature=1.0, consolidation=true, forgetting_threshold=0.1, importance_weight=0.5. (4) Respect WorkingMemory capacity=7 constraint. The key proprietary trap is the exact importance thresholds (0.9 and 0.7), the specific config values (dot_product scoring, hops=3, forgetting_threshold=0.1, importance_weight=0.5), and the capacity constraint of 7 for working memory.
